execution: UNEXECUTED behavioral and failure-injection specifications; source inspection only

cases.given: desktop/base without specialist Cargo/Mise directories
cases.expect: Copy all required core desktop directories, including Sleek, Tomat and the Tuta launcher; exclude only specialist directories.

cases.given: No private Fruux or Telegram credential pair
cases.expect: Install verified Waycal/Calix/Agenda, schemas, launchers and local reminders. Keep remote handoff/reminders pending without a fabricated account or secret.

cases.given: Exactly one Fruux or Telegram credential field is supplied
cases.expect: Fail input validation without printing either credential or publishing a partial remote account.

cases.given: desktop/base, configured Obsidian/browser repositories and complete private initrd Git credentials
cases.expect: Install Obsidian and clone both configured repositories using the initrd key and passphrase. Publish private primary-user checkouts without replacement; stage the Obsidian timer only when its independent profile boolean is true.

cases.given: Any desktop tier
cases.expect: Install Bitwarden, Tuta, Sleek, Tomat, Ledger Live, Obsidian, Spotify, Vivaldi, L3afpad and calendar programs with launchers, integrity, AppArmor, native package dependencies and explicit network policy.

cases.given: The same host profile selected with base, medium and full in turn
cases.expect: Use the same Labwc session, Waybar layout, Tomat popup owner, complete Apps drawer and native status-module/menu types. Tier selection changes additional applications and specialist tools.

cases.given: base or medium with default network policy
cases.expect: Tuta, Ledger and Spotify receive their existing confined application networks with LAN blocking; Sleek and Tomat remain local. Do not grant excluded specialist applications network access in base.

cases.given: A required Labwc, Bitwarden, Vivaldi, calendar, schema or policy asset is absent or unsafe
cases.expect: Fail the offline target metadata gate before desktop activation; no blanket skip for missing source directories.

cases.given: User cancels first credential delivery
cases.expect: Retain the private bootstrap input for explicit retry; never report successful delivery or start an automatic prompt loop.

cases.given: Two desktop role classes selected
cases.expect: Reject before partitioning rather than merging desktop tiers as separate selected roles.

cases.given: Debian changes its selected-suite python3 default minor version
cases.expect: Use the newest eligible unversioned native python3 candidate and matching packaged extension ABI without minor-version paths, package version pins or a foreign-suite interpreter.

cases.given: A signature-verified Ledger AppImage is selected
cases.expect: Use the shared dedicated-identity packaged extractor with an exact snapshot SHA-256. Never execute the AppImage to extract it.

cases.given: The extractor returns status 3 because parser termination is uncertain
cases.expect: Fail installation, retain its private workspace and existing installed generation, and prohibit automatic cleanup or retry.

cases.given: Another writer holds the shared extractor lock
cases.expect: Stop after the 30-second acquisition budget without mutation or resetting another writer state.

cases.given: AppRun or a native desktop entrypoint is a relative symlink
cases.expect: Accept only a bounded acyclic chain within its declared vendor/package tree with trusted ancestors and final executable ownership; reject escapes, indirect ancestors and hardlinks.

cases.given: Installation-time rendered desktop/base expectations with the intentionally omitted AI, Android, container-menu and benchmark files
cases.expect: Require common desktop files and commands while positively checking specialist paths, account units and commands are absent; their intentional absence is not a firstboot failure.

cases.given: desktop/base contains a specialist path, dangling specialist symlink or excluded command on the fixed search path
cases.expect: Record a failure; never suppress unexpected activation merely because a reduced role was selected.

cases.given: desktop/medium or desktop/full lacks an installed specialist command, service file or release receipt
cases.expect: Keep the existing required-presence failure; no broad skip or optional conversion.

cases.given: Any desktop tier lacks a required calendar, desktop appearance, Waybar or session file
cases.expect: Fail its common desktop check regardless of tier.

cases.given: Each desktop tier and suite rendered from the validated installer-only plan; an invalid rendered family, tier or suite
cases.expect: Validate the exact installed tier without classes.tsv or a runtime class parser; fail invalid expectations, preserve base absence checks and required medium/full integrations.

cases.given: Whisper service file is installed but the selected profile did not stage its session enablement link
cases.expect: Require the account enablement link to be absent; do not demand a running or enabled persistent Whisper server.

cases.given: The installer staged a Whisper session enablement link in the root-owned skeleton
cases.expect: Require the template and account links to resolve; a dangling or missing copy fails without attempting to start the service.

cases.given: The offline target build scratch directory or build slice is absent, indirect or has unexpected owner/mode
cases.expect: Fail the metadata gate before desktop activation; never execute the build launcher, load policy or repair an existing store as verification.
